environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in a container with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile loaded via container runtime security context. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for a targeted set of syscalls: specifically execve (nr 59), execveat (nr 322), ptrace (nr 101), and the socket family (socket nr 41, connect nr 42, bind nr 49). The profile's defaultAction is SCMP_ACT_ALLOW with these specific denials in the syscalls array. Note: the Flask process itself is started via the container entrypoint before the profile takes effect on child processes (using SCMP_FLTATR_CTL_NNP with no_new_privs bit), meaning the parent gunicorn/flask process runs normally but any subprocess.run() or os.exec*() calls will receive EPERM. Profile applied via Kubernetes securityContext.seccompProfile with type Localhost referencing /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/flask-upload-hardened.json.

config.note: Parent process (PID 1 gunicorn) is exempt via entrypoint exec before profile inheritance; child processes inherit the restricted profile via no_new_privs
